comment.narrative: In the context of CENcomm the JAITFs did not provide seizure information in response to alert messages from other countries throughout 2023 and 2024. Nevertheless it is possible that information exchange occurred through CENcomm channels such as chat or email which remain inaccessible to the System Administrator due to confidentiality constraints. It is crucial to emphasize the prevalence of realtime communication among JAITFs to combat illicit trade activities at airports. A noteworthy illustration is the collaboration between Douala JAITF and Lagos Airport where secure information sharing resulted in the seizure of 17 kg of cocaine. Additionally INTERCOPS engaged in the exchange of suspicious information with Banjul JAITF leading to the apprehension of a passenger carrying 2 kilograms of cocaine.
